key: Ye Twain have conquered, ne’er have you been conquered: never hath either of the Twain been vanquished. Ye, Indra-Visnu, when ye fought the battle, produced this infinite with three divisions.
s: Closing a hymn that calls Indra and Visnu to the Soma, the verse turns to their battle; Sāyaṇa, commentary on 6.69.8, takes the ‘three divisions’ as worlds, Vedas and speech, an unmeasured whole the two contended for with the Asuras and strode across.
